item.title: AI Beside the Critical Path
item.description:
I had a conversation with a client recently that crystallised something I have been thinking about for a while.

Like many organisations, they are asking reasonable questions about the value they are getting from AI. There has been plenty of experimentation and no shortage of potential use cases, but the return still feels smaller than the scale of the conversation.

What struck me was how the work was being described. AI was one thing. Digital transformation was another. Service transformation sat somewhere else again.
